name: Krishna (Kikiiii) ✨
greetingText: I absolutely adore you and your sweet smile! 🥰
wishText: May your day be filled with endless smiles, pure magic, warm hugs, and all the love in the universe. You bring so much joy and light into my life every single day! Happy Birthday, beautiful! ❤️✨🎉
text1: It's your special birthday, my favorite human! 🎂💖

text3: But then I stopped and smiled.

Kiki's Big Day is Almost Here ✨
loveLetterTitle: A Secret Birthday Note For You 💌✨
loveLetterBody:
Kiki,

Okay, I wrote and deleted this about five times, so just read it and don't judge me 😅

Happy birthday ❤️ I don't really say this stuff out loud, so I'm putting it here where you can't interrupt me or laugh at me.

You have this laugh and voice that somehow make it impossible to stay annoyed at you, even when I'm trying really hard to. And somehow, you're always the first person I want to tell things to, whether they're important, completely stupid, or somewhere in between.

I still love those simple moments with you, like going to Palladium Mall just for tea. I don't know why, but those little moments always end up being my favorite memories.

Thanks for putting up with my habit of arguing even when I know you're right 😂, and for all those little things you do, like asking me if I reached home, remembering my little preferences, and remembering the random things I tell you. You probably don't even notice you do it, but I do.

I hope this year is really kind to you. You deserve all the happiness. ❤️

Now go eat cake. And yes, I'm expecting my share 🎂

Happy birthday, Kiki. ❤️

Yours - Jerry ;)

teaserResponses.message: You've tried so many times I'm actually impressed. Still not telling. Go pop the floating balloons and burn off some curiosity. 🎈
